bash -c '
cursor=""
prev_cursor=""
: > /tmp/leo_ts.txt
while true; do
  if [ -z "$cursor" ]; then
    resp=$(curl -s -X POST https://slack.com/api/conversations.history -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" -d "token=<TOKEN>&channel=C_IDB&limit=999")
  else
    resp=$(curl -s -X POST https://slack.com/api/conversations.history -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" --data-urlencode "token=<TOKEN>" --data-urlencode "channel=C_IDB" --data-urlencode "limit=999" --data-urlencode "cursor=$cursor")
  fi
  cursor=$(echo "$resp" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"response_metadata\",{}).get(\"next_cursor\") or \"\")")
  echo "$resp" | python3 -c "
import sys,json
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
for m in d.get(\"messages\",[]):
    if m.get(\"user\")==\"U_LEO\":
        print(m[\"ts\"])
" >> /tmp/leo_ts.txt
  count=$(wc -l < /tmp/leo_ts.txt)
  echo "page done, cursor=[$cursor], leo_count=$count"
  if [ -z "$cursor" ] || [ "$cursor" = "$prev_cursor" ]; then
    break
  fi
  prev_cursor="$cursor"
  sleep 0.2
done
echo "TOTAL LEO C_IDB: $(wc -l < /tmp/leo_ts.txt)"
'
